errors.evidence: The description presents an incomplete list for the Beneficence category, omitting four principles shown in the chart: "Recognize the Responsibility of the Occupation", "Ethical research", "Open Discussion and Fair Charging of Fees", and "Respect the Decision-making of Incompetent/Competent Patient".
